title: Weeknight Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
summary: A reliable, kid-friendly classic that comes together in about 30 minutes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, brown the ground beef with the onion and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat, about 8 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then stir in the marinara sauce, oregano, salt, and pepper flakes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.
Serve topped with grated parmesan.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
summary: One pan, minimal cleanup, and endlessly customizable toppings.
ingredientLines: 1.5 lbs chicken breast, sliced into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken, peppers, and onion with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast for 18-20 minutes, stirring halfway, until chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas and serve everything family-style with lime wedges and sour cream.

title: Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
summary: A cozy, one-pot dinner that's ready in half an hour.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté the onion and garlic until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth, then bring to a simmer.
Stir in the tortellini and cook according to package time.
Stir in the cream and spinach and cook until spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and serve topped with fresh basil.

title: Honey Garlic Salmon
summary: A quick, high-protein dinner with a sweet-savory glaze.
instructions: Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Sear salmon in a hot skillet skin-side up for 3-4 minutes, then flip.
Pour the sauce over the salmon and simmer 2-3 minutes until glazed and cooked through.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli.

title: Loaded Black Bean Tacos
summary: A fast vegetarian night that still feels hearty.
instructions: Warm the black beans in a saucepan with cumin, chili powder, and garlic powder, mashing some for texture.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or the oven.
Fill each tortilla with beans, avocado, cheese, and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.

title: Classic Turkey Chili
summary: Makes great leftovers and freezes well for a busy week.
instructions: Brown the turkey with onion, bell pepper, and garlic in a large pot over medium heat.
Stir in kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve topped with shredded cheese.

title: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken Thighs
summary: Crispy skin, minimal ingredients, big flavor.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and spread on a sheet pan.
Pat chicken thighs dry, rub with remaining olive oil, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Nestle chicken skin-side up among the potatoes with lemon slices and garlic.
Roast 35-40 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and skin is crisp.

title: Veggie Fried Rice
summary: A great way to use up leftover rice and whatever vegetables are on hand.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and scramble the eggs; set aside.
Add remaining oil, garlic, and peas and carrots, stir-frying 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions and toss to combine.

title: Baked Ziti
summary: A make-ahead-friendly baked pasta the whole family can agree on.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook ziti until just shy of al dente.
Mix ricotta, egg, half the parmesan, Italian seasoning, and salt in a bowl.
Toss the pasta with marinara sauce and the ricotta mixture.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with mozzarella and remaining parmesan.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Veggies
summary: Toss it together, roast, done — great for busy weeknights.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss all ingredients together on a large sheet pan.
Roast 30-35 minutes, stirring halfway, until potatoes are tender and sausage is browned.
